faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 21st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech degree in Electronics & Communication Eng., Biomedical Eng., or Mechanical Eng. with a specialization in microfluidics & MEMS, or related fields, with a minimum of 60% marks and must be GATE/NET qualified.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, details of which are in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Silchar JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role.
